research_question: Do channel-degeneracy and integer-contract findings track architecture, converter generation, quantization recipe, or their interaction?
classification_rule: Artifact-level class is a coarse routing label. Per-op and per-tensor quantization states remain the measurement unit for selective or mixed-scheme artifacts.

cohorts.label: Legacy Google-hosted quantized artifacts
cohorts.method: Use immutable artifact SHA-256 identities. Do not infer an exact converter binary from year alone.

cohorts.label: TensorFlow MLIR converter
cohorts.admission_gate: Pin source checkpoint SHA, TensorFlow package and wheel hash, converter flags, representative dataset identity, random seeds, output SHA-256, and numerical parity results.

cohorts.label: LiteRT Torch direct PyTorch conversion
cohorts.verified_claim: A torch.export-compatible PyTorch model can be converted directly to a .tflite artifact.
cohorts.rejected_overstatement: This does not prove that every PyTorch model previously required a PyTorch-to-ONNX-to-TensorFlow-to-TensorFlow.js chain, nor that all dynamic shapes are categorically unsupported.
cohorts.admission_gate: Record source repository and revision, checkpoint hash, model factory, example input shapes and dtypes, dynamic-shape policy, package inventory, converter options, output hash, and source-versus-LiteRT parity.

cohorts.label: AI Edge Quantizer selective and mixed schemes
cohorts.verified_claim: Recipes can scope dynamic, weight-only, or static quantization to selected operators; unspecified operators can remain FP32.
cohorts.engine_implication: A single artifact label is not a sufficient research denominator. Persist per-op compute precision, explicit dequantization, tensor storage dtype, granularity, symmetry, and scale-axis state.
cohorts.admission_gate: Pin the FP32 source artifact hash, quantizer package, recipe source and hash, all calibration sample identities and ordering, random seeds, output hash, and FP32-versus-quantized quality metrics.

litert_js.deepbom_status: The browser runtime path is implemented with @litertjs/core and a WASM accelerator request. A report remains not_assessed until the user runs the local consequence experiment.

tensorflow_2_21_correction.not_established_by_release_notes: The release notes do not by themselves prove that previously CPU-fallback operators are delegated to a particular quantized accelerator. Runtime delegation and hardware execution require backend-specific evidence.
